thread:
mike-cs: fyi — ACME hit a hard failure after we pushed the pinned-model upgrade yesterday. Their vector DB (weaviate) started rejecting inserts with
expected_dim=1536 got=1024. They say nothing in their code changed.

acme-engineer: yep, we started seeing index rejects around 03:12 UTC. All inserts started failing. sample log: `vector size mismatch: expected 1536, got 1024`. We verified our index schema is unchanged.

jess-support: ack — can you paste the exact API request/response you see from our embeddings endpoint? Also which model alias are you calling?

acme-engineer: calling `model: rwd-embed-legacy:2026-02-18` (we pinned this last month). Request body (sanitized):
```json
{"model": "rwd-embed-legacy:2026-02-18", "input": ["small doc text"], "batch_size": 16}
```
response snippet:
```json
{"data": [{"embedding": [/* 1024 floats */]}], "model": "rwd-embed-legacy"}
```

ankur-eng: interesting — response model field shows `rwd-embed-legacy` but vector length is 1024. possible causes: model variant mapping changed under the alias (alias now points to a new underlying checkpoint with smaller embed dim), or a quantized/latent projection difference.

sarah-sre: I checked the alias mapping in model-registry: alias `rwd-embed-legacy:2026-02-18` was remapped during yesterday's rollout to `rwd-embed-legacy-v2` (internal note: v2 uses a different architecture, embed_dim=1024) for perf testing. The rollout was supposed to be canary-only but routing policy leaked to some customers due to a routing rule bug.

mike-cs: omg. ACME pinned the alias on their side expecting 1536 vectors. They didn't pin a specific checkpoint, just the alias.

jess-support: steps to mitigate for the customer: 1) re-map their alias back to the older checkpoint (server-side) 2) flush any inference caches, 3) re-run a small reindex on their side (or accept 1024 and rebuild index). Which option is faster?

ankur-eng: we can rollback alias mapping in ~10min if SRE approves. But we need to make sure other customers who intentionally moved to v2 aren't affected. Alternative: create an alias `rwd-embed-legacy-1536` and update the customer's account mapping to that alias only. That avoids global rollback.

sarah-sre: I can patch routing to pin ACME's tenant to the old checkpoint immediately. Doing it now. Also increasing logging on alias resolution.

deploy-bot: deploy started: patch/tenant-routing/2026-03-05T03:25Z (id: pr-5247).

sarah-sre: done — ACME tenant pinned to `rwd-embed-legacy-checkpoint-a`. Please confirm inserts resume.

acme-engineer: re-run now... inserts accepted ✅. vectors are back to 1536. thank you.

mike-cs: great. long-term we need to update docs and recommend customers pin to explicit model checksum (checkpoint) not just alias. Also add a warning in console when alias remap could change vector dimensionality.

ankur-eng: agreed. action items:
- Add a console UX tooltip about embed_dimension stability when pinning aliases (ENG-865)
- Add API field in model metadata: `embedding_dimension` so SDKs can validate before upload (ENG-866)
- Add an API error code for dimension mismatches (EMB_DIM_MISMATCH) so vector DBs and customers can programmatically handle it (ENG-867)
- Add a canary gating rule to prevent alias remap from affecting pinned tenants (SRE-321)

jess-support: also document a short repro checklist for CS when customers report this:
1) Confirm customer model field and alias used in request
2) Check `model-registry` alias->checkpoint mapping and `embedding_dimension` metadata
3) If mismatch, route to SRE for tenant pinning or rollback
4) Offer reindex assistance or temporary alias with old checkpoint

mike-cs: ACME asked for a short changelog entry and a postmortem. I'll draft a customer-friendly note explaining what happened and the remediation steps.

sarah-sre: creating internal postmortem ticket and linking logs. Will include timeline, faulty routing rule, and fix PR.

acme-engineer: one request — can you add a response header or body field in embeddings API that returns `embedding_dimension`? Would be super helpful for early detection on our side.

ankur-eng: planned (ENG-866). For a short-term workaround, we can add a warning in the `x-model-metadata` header with dimension info within 24 hours.

mike-cs: thanks team. closing once ENG/SRE tickets are in and customer note is sent. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: deploy finished: patch/tenant-routing/2026-03-05T03:26Z (id: pr-5247) — success.

sarah-sre: postmortem draft in #postmortems later today.

jess-support: closing loop with ACME via email template `embed-dim-mismatch-template-v1` — sent.

mike-cs: marking resolved in support tracker. will reopen if ACME reports further issues.
